title: Alarm clock with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#ff9b9b' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- clock face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- top bells -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='25' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='25' rx='11' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='11' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bell tops -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='18' r='4' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='18' r='4' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- clock hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='50' y2='38' stroke='#7a4a2a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='62' y2='56' stroke='#7a4a2a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='3' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='2' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='2' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='54' r='2' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='54' r='2' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <!-- smiling eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='47' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='47' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M43 59 Q50 66 57 59' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='84' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffb84d'/>
</svg>
